reply_text:
I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the deadline for the signed order form at Tamsin Cold Chain is **20 November**.

Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 Oct, and Dana is a member of that channel. Nothing has been posted there since that changes it. A keyword search of the brain for Tamsin and the order form found nothing else either. A deadline date is an account detail, not a money figure, so it was fine to share with her.

One odd thing: when I looked up the note I saved on 14 Oct in the brain, it came back empty. The date is still in Ilse's channel message, but the brain may not have kept the saved note.
